title: Michelle in the Garden Sun
style: Blues-influenced progressive swing with an experimental 80s edge, featuring syncopated electric piano, walking bass, and crisp drum grooves. Clean chorus electric guitars and atmospheric synth pads add retro shimmer, while the vocal is playful and soulful with catchy, swinging phrasing. Occasional chromatic runs and unexpected chord turns give a progressive feel, and layered call-and-response backing vocals enhance the hooky, sun-soaked mood.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[instrumental bluesy swing groove with 80s keys]

[Verse 1]
[playful soulful vocals]
Watch it glow when she’s near
Michelle Cone walking here
Through my garden, sun every day
Every petal comes alive
When she steps in, smiles so wide
That’s how much the garden loves Michelle in the sunshine

[Verse 2]
Soft wind hums, roots all sing
Leaves start to sway and swing
Bluesy colors bloom in the air
Little sparks of neon vines
Glow like an 80s sign
Every day she’s shining more life in the sunshine

[Chorus]
Oh Michelle, when you come around
The roses dance to that swingin’ sound
Every stem feels the rhythm you bring
Sun up high and the bluebirds sing
Oh Michelle, every step you take
Turns the soil awake, makes the whole earth shake
Garden hearts keep beating in time
Catching your light in a progressive sunshine

[Bridge]
Catchy breezes spin and twirl
Vines reach out in loops and swirls
Experimental colors in the sky
Every ray and every hue
Finds its way from me to you
Garden loves Michelle, lifting life to the sunshine

[Chorus]
Oh Michelle, when you come around
The roses dance to that swingin’ sound
Every stem feels the rhythm you bring
Sun up high and the bluebirds sing
Oh Michelle, every step you take
Turns the soil awake, makes the whole earth shake
Garden hearts keep beating in time
Catching your light in a progressive sunshine
